summary: Globavend Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing its subsidiary Risemind Holdings (Cayman) Limited entered a share purchase agreement to acquire 70% of Loomi Entertainment Group Limited from Zenith Green Limited for nominal consideration of US$70 in cash. Loomi is a digital entertainment company offering AI-powered micro-drama production and distribution in Southeast Asia. The seller, Tsz Ngo Yu, is both CFO/director of Globavend and sole owner of Zenith Green, making this a related-party transaction. Closing is expected by May 22, 2026. The target will be consolidated including an existing ~US$550,000 interest-free shareholder loan. The nominal price and tight timeline suggest a strategic restructuring; watch for regulatory approvals and related-party scrutiny.
